scope: Distinct Mālikī and Ḥanbalī fiqh works; bibliographic identities and explicit textual relationships. Editions, partial-volume republications and usul works are not counted as additional fiqh books.
method: Catalogue title pages checked against multiple scholarly reference articles, institutional bibliographies and national-library records. This is bibliographical verification, not textual collation. Arabic catalogue metadata has known errors; ambiguous dates were withheld and combined-volume author roles corrected.

sources.title: ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm Maḥmūd al-Dīb, Buhūtī (TDV)
sources.support: Author death 1051/1641; named commentaries and glosses, ʿUmdat al-ṭālib and its descendants.

sources.title: Salim Öğüt, Ḥaccāvī (TDV)
sources.support: Iqnāʿ, Zād, Ḥawāshī al-Tanqīḥ and respective textual relationships; death 968/1560 with older variant.

sources.title: Qatar Ministry of Awqāf: Maṭālib ulī al-nuhā
sources.support: Explicit Ghāya/Muntahā/Iqnāʿ compilation and Maṭālib commentary relationship.

sources.title: Al-Kulliyyāt al-fiqhiyya fī al-madhhab al-Ḥanbalī: source bibliography
sources.support: Bibliographic identification of Mustawʿib, Muḥarrar, Furūʿ, Tawḍīḥ and major Hanbali sources; pp.97–98.

sources.title: Tunisian National Library: Kifāyat al-ṭālib al-rabbānī
sources.support: Names al-Munūfī, 939 AH, and identifies the text as a commentary on Ibn Abī Zayd.

sources.title: UAE Ministry of Culture libraries: al-Sharḥ al-ṣaghīr
sources.support: Separates al-Dardīr’s matn/commentary from al-Ṣāwī’s marginal gloss; author life dates.

sources.title: Bulghat al-sālik: bibliographic card and author preface
sources.support: Author preface names Aqrab al-masālik and Bulghat al-sālik; edition distinguishes matn, commentary and gloss.

sources.title: Waqfeya: Kāfī al-mubtadī min al-ṭullāb
sources.support: Title and Ibn Balbān attribution.

sources.title: Takwin: Akhṣar al-mukhtaṣarāt, author preface
sources.support: Ibn Balbān expressly identifies Akhṣar as his abridgment of Kāfī al-mubtadī.

sources.title: Muḥammed Eroğlu, Ibn ʿĀshir al-Fāsī (TDV)
sources.support: Ibn ʿĀshir death 1040/1631 and explicit Mayyāra commentary on al-Murshid al-muʿīn.

sources.title: Shaykh ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī Centre library: Furūʿ and Taṣḥīḥ
sources.support: Separately identifies Ibn Mufliḥ as base-text author and al-Mardāwī as author of the marginal Taṣḥīḥ; dates 763 and 885 AH.

sources.title: National Library of Israel: Lawāmiʿ al-durar
sources.support: Explicitly identifies the work as a Khalīl commentary, with author name Muḥammad ibn Muḥammad Sālim al-Majlisī and death 1302 AH/1885 CE.

sources.title: ʿAbd Allāh al-Ḥabashī, Jāmiʿ al-shurūḥ wa-l-ḥawāshī: Majmūʿ al-Amīr
sources.support: Separately identifies al-Majmūʿ, the author’s commentary and Ḍawʾ al-shumūʿ as his gloss on that commentary, with manuscript locations and print witnesses.

sources.title: Majmaah University Library: al-ʿIqd al-mufrad
sources.support: Author name Abū ʿAyyāsha Muḥammad al-Bayyūmī al-Damanhūrī and death 1335 AH; distinct Ḥanbalī manual.
